## Strengths

### Approved peer directory

Team Brain has an explicit approved agent fixture for safe A2A routing.

### Shared search surface

Notes, links, summaries, docs, decks, and skills can contribute to search and topics.

## Weaknesses

### Sparse real team corpus

The fixture set is intentionally small and should grow only around existing plugins.

## Opportunities

### Topic synthesis

Draft links and summaries can feed topic extraction for private team maps.

## Threats

### Publishing drift

Pulling in Rover-style publishing plugins too early would blur Team Brain's identity.
